trigger: Choose Draft the invoice on a project with no designer, client, or studio association
today: Invoice project is missing its canonical billing tuple
path: Composer catches mutateAsync and prints the error in its custom box (invoice-composer.tsx:607-617,1390-1406); inline mutation metadata suppresses toast.
preKnowable: yes — selected project has designer_id, client_id, studio_id fields (:252, :565-577)
rewrite: This project needs a client and studio before you can draft an invoice. Link a client in the household sheet; ask your studio owner to name the studio if it is missing.
destination: Household sheet → Link a client; studio owner → Name the studio (hours-ledger)

trigger: Draft invoice after selected client differs from project's linked client
today: Invoice client does not match the selected project
path: Composer custom error box via catch; inline metadata prevents toast.
preKnowable: yes — selected project client_id versus selected client id
rewrite: This invoice’s client does not match the project. Choose the client linked to this project, or update the project’s client first.
destination: Household sheet → Link a client

trigger: Draft after project lookup fails (deleted/inaccessible project or database error)
today: Failed to load invoice project: {PostgREST message}
path: Composer catches and displays raw error in custom box.
preKnowable: no — lookup/RLS/transport result occurs at submit
rewrite: The project could not be loaded, so no invoice was created. Try again; if it continues, contact Patina support.
destination: Try again in composer; support if repeated

trigger: Draft with invalid or stale lines rejected by create_draft_invoice
today: Failed to create draft invoice: {RPC message}
path: Composer error box; raw RPC text is shown.
preKnowable: partly — client-side line fields are visible; authority, row changes, and database state are not
rewrite: The invoice details could not be saved. Review the lines and try again; if the details are correct, try again shortly.
destination: Composer line fields / Draft the invoice

trigger: Choose Draft when FF&E has no client price
today: Muted unpriced FF&E notice; no fix link (notice text in composer)
path: Composer notice, not an error alert; server rejection otherwise returns raw RPC message to custom box.
preKnowable: yes — FF&E price/coverage data
rewrite: This item needs a client price before it can be billed. Add its price in the project’s FF&E schedule, then draft the invoice again.
destination: FF&E schedule item price control (none linked from notice)

trigger: Draft while tracked hours have no studio rate
today: set the studio rate →
path: Disabled line control with link to /desk?account=studio.
preKnowable: yes — rate-pending hour state
rewrite: These hours need a studio rate before they can be billed. Ask your studio owner to set the rate.
destination: /desk?account=studio → studio rate

trigger: Enter deposit percentage above remaining balance
today: Existing role=alert deposit validation text (inline, verbatim varies with line)
path: Inline composer alert before submit.
preKnowable: yes — deposit percentage and remaining balance shown in composer
rewrite: This deposit is more than the remaining balance for this item. Lower the deposit amount to continue.
destination: Deposit percentage field

trigger: Draft causes a later time-claim step to fail after draft header creation
today: Thrown claim error, possibly followed by rollback message containing raw invoice id (:647)
path: Composer catches and displays custom box; compensating delete is attempted.
preKnowable: no — concurrent claim/state/RPC result
rewrite: The invoice could not finish because the selected hours changed. Refresh the project and try again; contact support if an invoice was left behind.
destination: Composer → Try again; no reconciliation destination if draft deletion also fails

trigger: Attach billing lines after creating draft, while source purchase/FF&E row changes or fails validation
today: add_invoice_billing_lines: {SQL validation text, ids and possibly cents}
path: Composer catch/custom box, with raw RPC error; compensating draft delete attempted.
preKnowable: partly — loaded line attributes and amounts; concurrent status/authority can change
rewrite: One or more project items could not be added to this invoice. Review the item and amount, then try again.
destination: Composer’s FF&E/billing line editor

trigger: Draft studio invoice for a household not on designer’s studio roster
today: Failed to create draft studio invoice: studio invoice household not found or access denied
path: Composer catches and displays raw error in custom box.
preKnowable: yes — selected household/studio roster data, if loaded
rewrite: This household is not on the studio’s client list. Add the household to the studio roster, then draft the invoice again.
destination: Studio roster / client list (no destination linked in composer)

trigger: Draft studio invoice using missing/unauthorized studio
today: Failed to create draft studio invoice: studio invoice studio not found or access denied
path: Composer custom error box.
preKnowable: yes — selected studio/membership data when available
rewrite: The selected studio is not available to you. Ask a studio owner to confirm your studio access.
destination: Studio settings / owner access (none linked)

trigger: Draft studio invoice with project-only line kind (time, milestone or FF&E)
today: Failed to create draft studio invoice: a studio invoice carries ad-hoc lines only; milestone, time, and ffe lines are project-bound
path: Composer custom error box with raw RPC text.
preKnowable: yes — composer mode and line kinds
rewrite: Studio invoices can include custom lines only. Remove project hours, milestones, or FF&E items, or switch to a project invoice.
destination: Studio composer line editor / project invoice mode

trigger: Draft a milestone invoice when milestone is already billed or otherwise unavailable
today: Could not draft the invoice — {raw RPC message}; observed test: “Could not draft the invoice — milestone is already billed”
path: Account-band inline text; raw RPC message appended.
preKnowable: yes — milestone billing state from account data
rewrite: This milestone is already on an invoice. Open its invoice to review it.
destination: Invoice folio for billed milestone (destination may not exist in account band)

trigger: Send or remind when invoice has no recipient, is not issued, not found, or caller lacks authority
today: Bare edge-function detail/error code (e.g. no_recipient, invoice_not_issued) displayed as message
path: Accounts/folio caller catches; inline act failure (errorSurface inline) or Document inline route; no toast there.
preKnowable: partly — recipient and invoice status are loaded; authorization can be stale
rewrite: This invoice could not be sent because it has no client email address. Add the client’s email, then send the invoice again.
destination: Household sheet → client contact/email; folio → Send invoice

trigger: Send email and edge function/provider fails or times out
today: Returned detail/error code or transport message; may not establish whether email was delivered
path: useSendInvoice rejects; R83 inline act failure on folio/receivables, otherwise mutation toast.
preKnowable: no — provider/network result; timeout delivery may be uncertain
rewrite: The email could not be confirmed as sent. Check the invoice’s delivery status before sending again.
destination: Invoice folio → delivery status; if unresolved, Patina support

trigger: Client starts checkout on stale, void, paid, inaccessible or invalid invoice
today: InvoiceCheckoutError raw detail/code, or “Checkout returned an invalid response. No redirect was started.” / incomplete/malformed variants
path: Checkout mutation error; client pay-page handler (outside designer toast path); legacy mutation otherwise global toast.
preKnowable: partly — invoice status/balance/link state; session creation and malformed response are not
rewrite: This invoice is no longer ready for payment. Contact the studio to confirm the balance and ask for an updated payment link.
destination: Client pay page → contact studio; designer folio → Regenerate link if payable

trigger: Regenerate link while checkout is in progress
today: A payment is in progress on this invoice. Try again later.
path: Folio handles mutateAsync rejection and renders inline act failure; errorSurface inline suppresses toast.
preKnowable: partly — checkout attempt state can be queried but may race
rewrite: A payment is underway on this invoice. Wait for it to finish before replacing the payment link.
destination: Invoice folio → Regenerate payment link (retry after attempt settles)

trigger: Regenerate link for draft/void/non-payable or invoice unavailable to actor
today: “This invoice has no link to replace.” / “This invoice could not be opened.”
path: Folio inline act failure (inline meta).
preKnowable: yes — invoice status; authorization may be stale
rewrite: This invoice cannot take payment in its current state. Open an issued invoice with a balance, or ask a studio owner to check access.
destination: Invoice folio (none if invoice is draft/void; must issue or use another invoice)

trigger: Regenerate link RPC returns unexpected error or non-string response
today: Raw PostgREST message or “Failed to regenerate the invoice link”
path: Folio inline act failure when called with errorSurface inline.
preKnowable: no — service/RPC result
rewrite: A new payment link could not be made. Try again; if it continues, contact Patina support.
destination: Invoice folio → Regenerate payment link; support if repeated

trigger: Client submits check intent but edge function refuses or fails
today: Bare detail/error code or transport message; fallback “Failed to notify the designer”
path: Client pay-page mutation handler; legacy path may show global toast.
preKnowable: no — notification/edge result
rewrite: The studio was not notified that you plan to mail a check. Try again, or contact the studio directly.
destination: Client pay page → Notify studio; direct contact if it fails

trigger: Record a manual payment when invoice state, balance, amount or authority fails RPC validation
today: Raw PostgREST/RPC message (including database wording)
path: Invoice folio catches and shows ActFailLine/inline alert; errorSurface inline suppresses toast.
preKnowable: partly — current balance, entered amount, status; concurrent payment/authority is not
rewrite: This payment could not be recorded because the invoice changed or the amount is no longer due. Refresh the invoice and check its remaining balance.
destination: Invoice folio → Record payment form

trigger: Chase overdue invoice or send reminder after status/ownership changes
today: Raw chase RPC message; send path exposes bare edge error code
path: Receivables page inline failure (send/chase); no global toast when inline metadata.
preKnowable: partly — due date/status visible; ownership and concurrent state can change
rewrite: The reminder could not be recorded because this invoice changed. Refresh receivables and try again.
destination: Accounts → Receivables → Send reminder / Chase

trigger: Void invoice that is paid, already void, inaccessible, or has an invalid reason
today: Raw PostgREST/RPC message
path: Invoice folio inline failure through errorSurface inline.
preKnowable: partly — status/payment information; race/permission may not be
rewrite: This invoice could not be voided because its status changed or payment was recorded. Refresh the invoice and review its payment history.
destination: Invoice folio → Void invoice / payment history

trigger: Delete draft after it was issued, removed, or access changed
today: Raw PostgREST error; a no-row status-filter delete may appear successful
path: Composer rollback error is caught into custom box; otherwise global mutation toast outside Document.
preKnowable: partly — draft status; concurrent update/authorization is not
rewrite: This draft could not be removed because it is no longer a draft. Refresh the invoice list before continuing.
destination: Invoice folio/list; composer rollback has no dedicated recovery destination

trigger: Add or edit line on invoice that is no longer a draft or has invalid line data
today: Raw PostgREST error; totals read/update can also throw raw PostgREST message
path: Mutation toast outside Document; Document surface routes inline but line form may not render its own alert.
preKnowable: partly — status and entered line values; server concurrency unknown
rewrite: This line could not be saved because the invoice changed or its details are invalid. Refresh the draft and check the line before saving again.
destination: Invoice composer line editor

trigger: Delete line from non-draft invoice or line already removed
today: Raw PostgREST error (or no-row delete appears successful); totals error raw
path: Mutation toast/Document inline routing; no dedicated line-delete error box identified.
preKnowable: partly — status and line list; race unknown
rewrite: This line could not be removed because the invoice changed. Refresh the draft and try again.
destination: Invoice composer line editor

trigger: Billing mutation throws PostgREST/network/API error on non-inline surface
today: PostgREST errors generally pass through as AppError(error.message); Axios uses response message/default; network gets “Service temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.” or “Network error. Please check your connection”
path: MutationCache handleApiError → toast unless inline/silent metadata or document inline surface; auth routes to sign-in/toast. Query background refetch with cached data does not toast.
preKnowable: no — generic infrastructure failure
rewrite: The billing change could not be saved. Check your connection and try again; contact Patina support if it keeps happening.
destination: Retry at the original billing act; support if repeated
